svg.title: Broad Peak — mountain relief
svg.desc: Western massif from the Godwin-Austen approach. Long summit crest, rocky foresummit, central summit and broad glacial flanks. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Kogo. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:7_15_BroadPeak.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
